title: Deterministic regression tests
story: As a maintainer, I want tests that lock known outputs so regressions are caught.
description: Lock engine behaviour with deterministic tests covering the core calculations.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover baseline deficit, static calc, feedback lag and deficit % GDP
Baseline-file validation paths are tested (missing file, missing metric, non-numeric)
The default scenario output is locked as a regression fixture
Identical inputs always produce identical outputs
